objective: Reduce first-transition sash-latch silhouette/highlight discontinuity without claiming rendered quality. Preserve the 34 mm / 130 degree crescent physical envelope from 32-ring LOD0 into a 16-ring LOD1 proxy, bind that proxy into the same fail-closed reflection evidence epoch, and keep actual native-4K temporal pixels authoritative for visible_lod_pop and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer.

decisionRationale.observedSourceRisk: The parent sash-latch implementation used a continuous 32-ring curved LOD0 lever after the previous refinement, but its LOD1 proxy still substituted a single 12 x 70 x 8 mm rotated rectangular lever. Animated cross-fade does not guarantee perceptual continuity when the two silhouettes and highlight trajectories represent materially different forms.
decisionRationale.priorityReason: visible_lod_pop is a critical automatic FAIL and Temporal/LOD/Aliasing carries 5 points with a hard minimum of 4. Preserving the same manufactured curve envelope through the first LOD transition has higher gate value than adding another decorative detail while Unity rendering is unavailable.
decisionRationale.implementationChoice: Keep LOD1 as one combined renderer for real-time cost discipline, but replace only its lever form with a 16-ring swept crescent sharing LOD0 radius, sweep, section and corner break. The deterministic proxy overwrites GM_SashLatch_L1_Proxy_P0..P7 in place, so existing LODGroup renderer references remain valid.
decisionRationale.evidencePolicy: Source geometry/contract checks award zero Visual Fidelity points. A 32-to-16 ring transition can still pop, shimmer or snap highlights in motion; only actual native-4K still/temporal evidence can clear those defects.
